category_name_en: A Better Start to the Day
clue_en: Which countertop appliance browns slices of bread with radiant heat?
clue_et: Milline köögikapil seisev seade pruunistab saiaviile kiirgussoojusega?
explanation_en: A toaster exposes bread slices to radiant heat until their surfaces brown.
explanation_et: Röster kuumutab saiaviile kiirgussoojusega, kuni nende pind pruunistub.

category_name_en: A Better Start to the Day
clue_en: Which egg dish is made by stirring beaten eggs gently as they cook in a pan?
clue_et: Milline munaroog valmib lahtiklopitud mune pannil küpsemise ajal segades?
explanation_en: Scrambled eggs form soft curds when beaten eggs are stirred during cooking.
explanation_et: Munapuder muutub pehmeks teraliseks roaks, kui lahtiklopitud mune küpsemise ajal segada.

category_name_en: A Better Start to the Day
clue_en: Which crunchy breakfast mix is baked into clusters, often with oats, nuts, and honey?
clue_et: Milline krõbe hommikusöögisegu küpsetatakse tavaliselt kaerahelvestest, pähklitest ja meest kobarateks?
explanation_en: Granola is baked until its grains, nuts, and sweetener form crisp clusters.
explanation_et: Granolat küpsetatakse, kuni teraviljast, pähklitest ja magustajast tekivad krõbedad kobarad.

category_name_en: A Better Start to the Day
clue_en: Which North African and Middle Eastern breakfast cooks eggs directly in a spiced tomato sauce?
clue_et: Millises Põhja-Aafrika ja Lähis-Ida hommikusöögiroas küpsetatakse munad otse vürtsikas tomatikastmes?
explanation_en: Shakshuka poaches eggs in a sauce of tomatoes, peppers, onions, and spices.
explanation_et: Šakšukas pošeeritakse munad tomati-, paprika-, sibula- ja vürtsikastmes.

category_name_en: A Better Start to the Day
clue_en: Which Asian breakfast dish cooks rice in abundant water until it becomes soft and spoonable?
clue_et: Milline Aasia hommikusöök valmib riisi rohkes vees keetes, kuni see muutub pehmeks ja lusikaga söödavaks?
explanation_en: Congee is made by cooking rice in abundant water until the grains soften into porridge.
explanation_et: Congee valmistamiseks keedetakse riisi rohkes vees, kuni terad muutuvad pehmeks pudruks.

clue_en: Which cinema snack appears when heated maize kernels burst and turn inside out?
clue_et: Milline kinosaali suupiste tekib siis, kui kuumutatud maisiterad lõhkevad ja end pahupidi pööravad?
explanation_en: Steam pressure bursts a popcorn kernel and rapidly expands its cooked starch.
explanation_et: Aururõhk lõhestab popkornitera ning paisutab selle küpsenud tärklise kiiresti.

clue_en: A squeeze of which tart juice can slow the browning of a cut apple?
clue_et: Millise hapu mahla lisamine võib aeglustada lahtilõigatud õuna pruunistumist?
explanation_en: Lemon juice is acidic and contains antioxidants that slow enzymatic browning.
explanation_et: Sidrunimahl on happeline ja sisaldab antioksüdante, mis aeglustavad ensümaatilist pruunistumist.

clue_en: Which creamy sauce keeps droplets of oil mixed with water and egg yolk instead of separating?
clue_et: Millises kreemjas kastmes püsivad õlitilgad vee ja munakollasega segunenuna, mitte ei eraldu?
explanation_en: Egg-yolk emulsifiers help mayonnaise hold oil and water together.
explanation_et: Munakollases olevad emulgaatorid aitavad majoneesis õli ja vett koos hoida.

clue_en: Which sealed pot cooks food faster by raising the pressure and boiling point of water?
clue_et: Milline suletud pott küpsetab toitu kiiremini, tõstes rõhku ja vee keemistemperatuuri?
explanation_en: A pressure cooker traps steam, allowing water and food to reach a higher temperature.
explanation_et: Kiirkeedupott hoiab auru kinni, nii et vesi ja toit saavutavad kõrgema temperatuuri.

clue_en: What chickpea-cooking liquid can be whipped into a foam much like egg white?
clue_et: Millist kikerherneste keeduvedelikku saab vahustada peaaegu nagu munavalget?
explanation_en: Aquafaba contains dissolved starches and proteins that let it trap air as a foam.
explanation_et: Aquafaba sisaldab lahustunud tärklisi ja valke, mis aitavad vahul õhku kinni hoida.

clue_en: Which enclosed kitchen appliance bakes food with controlled heat?
clue_et: Milline suletud köögiseade küpsetab toitu reguleeritud kuumusega?
explanation_en: An oven surrounds food with controlled heat for baking and roasting.
explanation_et: Ahi ümbritseb toitu reguleeritud kuumusega, et seda küpsetada või röstida.

clue_en: Which cylindrical tool is rolled over dough to flatten it?
clue_et: Millist silindrikujulist tööriista veeretatakse taina peal, et seda õhemaks rullida?
explanation_en: A rolling pin spreads dough into a thinner, even sheet.
explanation_et: Tainarull muudab taina õhemaks ja ühtlasemaks kihiks.

clue_en: Which heat-resistant paper lines a baking tray so biscuits are less likely to stick?
clue_et: Millise kuumakindla paberiga kaetakse küpsetusplaat, et küpsised selle külge kinni ei jääks?
explanation_en: Baking parchment provides a heat-resistant, non-stick surface on a tray.
explanation_et: Küpsetuspaber moodustab plaadile kuumakindla pinna, mille külge toit kergesti ei nakku.

clue_en: Which cone-shaped bag lets a baker pipe neat lines or rosettes of icing?
clue_et: Millise koonilise koti abil saab pagar pritsida glasuurist korralikke jooni või rosette?
explanation_en: A piping bag pushes soft icing or dough through a shaped nozzle.
explanation_et: Pritskott surub pehme glasuuri või taina läbi kujuga otsaku.

clue_en: Which gentle heating method places a bowl of custard or chocolate over or inside hot water?
clue_et: Millise õrna kuumutusviisi puhul asetatakse vanillikreemi või šokolaadiga anum kuuma vee kohale või sisse?
explanation_en: A bain-marie surrounds a container with hot water to moderate the heat.
explanation_et: Vesivann ümbritseb anuma kuuma veega ja muudab kuumutamise ühtlasemaks.

clue_en: Which huge summer fruit has a green rind and juicy red flesh dotted with dark seeds?
clue_et: Millisel suurel suveviljal on roheline koor ja mahlane punane viljaliha, milles leidub tumedaid seemneid?
explanation_en: A watermelon is a large melon with a hard rind and water-rich flesh.
explanation_et: Arbuus on kõva koore ja väga veerikka viljalihaga suur melon.

clue_en: Which small brown fuzzy fruit is bright green inside and shares its nickname with a New Zealand bird?
clue_et: Milline väike pruun karvane vili on seest erkroheline ning jagab nime Uus-Meremaa linnuga?
explanation_en: Kiwifruit was given its commercial name after New Zealand’s kiwi bird.
explanation_et: Kiivivili sai oma kaubandusliku nime Uus-Meremaa kiivilinnu järgi.

clue_en: Which red fruit appears to carry its tiny seeds on the outside?
clue_et: Millise punase vilja pinnal paistavad olevat väikesed seemned?
explanation_en: The visible specks on a strawberry are small fruits called achenes.
explanation_et: Maasika pinnal nähtavad täpikesed on väikesed viljad, mida nimetatakse pähklikesteks.

clue_en: Which creamy green fruit has one large stone and is the base of guacamole?
clue_et: Millisel kreemja rohelise viljal on üks suur luuseeme ning sellest valmistatakse guacamole’t?
explanation_en: Avocado flesh surrounds one large seed and is mashed for guacamole.
explanation_et: Avokaado viljaliha ümbritseb üht suurt seemet ning seda tambitakse guacamole valmistamiseks.

clue_en: Which soft fruit hides many tiny flowers inside the structure that later becomes the part we eat?
clue_et: Millise pehme vilja paljud pisikesed õied peituvad selle osa sees, mida hiljem sööme?
explanation_en: A fig’s enclosed flower structure develops into the fleshy multiple fruit we eat.
explanation_et: Viigimarja suletud õisik areneb lihakaks koguviljaks, mida sööme.

clue_en: Which grain is commonly steamed or boiled and serves as a staple for billions of people?
clue_et: Millist teravilja tavaliselt aurutatakse või keedetakse ning mida söövad põhitoiduna miljardid inimesed?
explanation_en: Rice is a cereal grain cooked as a staple food across much of the world.
explanation_et: Riis on teravili, mida süüakse suurel osal maailmast keedetud põhitoiduna.

clue_en: Which family of foods includes spaghetti and penne and is often made from durum wheat?
clue_et: Millisesse toiduperesse kuuluvad spagetid ja penne ning mida valmistatakse sageli kõvanisust?
explanation_en: Many dried pasta shapes are made from durum-wheat semolina and water.
explanation_et: Paljud kuivatatud pastavormid valmistatakse kõvanisu mannast ja veest.

clue_en: Which small lens-shaped pulses may be green, brown, red, or black?
clue_et: Millised väikesed läätsekujulised kaunviljad võivad olla rohelised, pruunid, punased või mustad?
explanation_en: Lentils are edible pulse seeds that come in several colours and cook without soaking.
explanation_et: Läätsed on eri värvi söödavad kaunviljaseemned, mida saab keeta ilma eelneva leotamiseta.

clue_en: Which North African staple consists of tiny steamed granules traditionally made from semolina?
clue_et: Milline Põhja-Aafrika põhitoit koosneb väikestest aurutatud terakestest, mida tehakse traditsiooniliselt mannast?
explanation_en: Couscous is made by rolling moistened semolina into small granules and steaming them.
explanation_et: Kuskussi valmistamiseks veeretatakse niisutatud manna väikesteks teradeks ja aurutatakse.

clue_en: Which quick-cooking grain consists of cracked wheat that has already been parboiled and dried?
clue_et: Milline kiiresti valmiv teravili koosneb eelkeedetud, kuivatatud ja purustatud nisuteradest?
explanation_en: Bulgur is made from wheat groats that are parboiled, dried, and cracked.
explanation_et: Bulgur valmistatakse nisuteradest, mis eelkeedetakse, kuivatatakse ja purustatakse.

clue_en: What brightly coloured part of a lemon is grated to add citrus aroma without much juice?
clue_et: Millist sidruni erksavärvilist osa riivitakse, et lisada toidule tsitruselõhna ilma rohke mahlata?
explanation_en: Lemon zest is the aromatic outer layer of the peel.
explanation_et: Sidrunikoorena kasutatav zest on koore aromaatne välimine kiht.

clue_en: Which dark fermented seasoning adds salty umami flavour to stir-fries and sushi?
clue_et: Milline tume kääritatud maitseaine lisab vokiroogadele ja sushile soolast umami maitset?
explanation_en: Soy sauce is a fermented liquid seasoning made chiefly from soybeans and wheat.
explanation_et: Sojakaste on peamiselt sojaubadest ja nisust valmistatud kääritatud vedel maitseaine.

clue_en: Which fragrant oil made from toasted seeds is often drizzled over an Asian dish near the end of cooking?
clue_et: Millist röstitud seemnetest valmistatud lõhnavat õli niristatakse Aasia roale sageli küpsetamise lõpus?
explanation_en: Toasted sesame oil has a strong nutty aroma and is commonly used as a finishing flavour.
explanation_et: Röstitud seesamiõlil on tugev pähkline lõhn ning seda kasutatakse sageli roa viimistlemiseks.

clue_en: Which small pickled flower buds add a sharp salty bite to dishes such as puttanesca?
clue_et: Millised väikesed marineeritud õienupud annavad näiteks puttanesca-kastmele teravalt soolaka maitse?
explanation_en: Capers are unopened flower buds preserved in salt or brine.
explanation_et: Kapparid on avanemata õienupud, mida säilitatakse soolas või soolvees.

clue_en: Which North African red chilli paste adds heat with peppers, garlic, and aromatic spices?
clue_et: Milline Põhja-Aafrika punane tšillipasta lisab teravust paprika, küüslaugu ja aromaatsete vürtsidega?
explanation_en: Harissa is a North African chilli paste seasoned with garlic and spices.
explanation_et: Harissa on Põhja-Aafrika tšillipasta, mida maitsestatakse küüslaugu ja vürtsidega.

clue_en: What simple cover can smother a small pan fire by cutting off its oxygen?
clue_et: Milline lihtne kate võib väikese pannipõlengu lämmatada, katkestades hapniku juurdepääsu?
explanation_en: A fitted lid can exclude oxygen from a small contained cooking fire.
explanation_et: Sobiv kaas võib katkestada väikese piiratud toidupõlengu hapnikuvarustuse.

clue_en: Which small alarm remembers when the biscuits should come out of the oven?
clue_et: Milline väike alarm tuletab meelde, millal tuleb küpsised ahjust välja võtta?
explanation_en: A kitchen timer sounds after a chosen interval so a cook need not watch the clock.
explanation_et: Köögitaimer annab valitud aja möödudes märku, nii et kokk ei pea kella jälgima.

clue_en: What bowl of very cold water quickly stops green vegetables cooking after blanching?
clue_et: Milline väga külma vee kauss peatab roheliste köögiviljade küpsemise kohe pärast blanšeerimist?
explanation_en: An ice bath cools blanched food rapidly and limits further cooking.
explanation_et: Jäävann jahutab blanšeeritud toidu kiiresti ning peatab edasise küpsemise.

clue_en: What smooth mixture of starch and cold liquid can rescue a sauce that is too thin?
clue_et: Milline tärklise ja külma vedeliku ühtlane segu aitab päästa liiga vedela kastme?
explanation_en: Starch dispersed in cold liquid can thicken a hot sauce without forming dry lumps.
explanation_et: Külmas vedelikus hajutatud tärklis paksendab kuuma kastet kuivade klompideta.

clue_en: What technique adds liquid to a hot pan and loosens its flavourful browned bits into a sauce?
clue_et: Millise võtte puhul lisatakse kuumale pannile vedelikku ning lahustatakse pruunistunud maitsekad osakesed kastmesse?
explanation_en: Deglazing dissolves browned pan residue so it can flavour a sauce.
explanation_et: Deglaseerimine lahustab pannile pruunistunud jäägid, et need annaksid kastmele maitset.

category_name_en: Desserts from Oven, Fridge, and Fryer
clue_en: Which dense chocolate bake is commonly cut into small squares?
clue_et: Milline tihke šokolaadiküpsetis lõigatakse tavaliselt väikesteks ruutudeks?
explanation_en: A brownie is a dense chocolate bake usually served as a square or bar.
explanation_et: Brownie on tihke šokolaadiküpsetis, mida serveeritakse tavaliselt ruudu või batoonina.

category_name_en: Desserts from Oven, Fridge, and Fryer
clue_en: Which light sweet is made by whipping egg whites with sugar before drying or baking it?
clue_et: Milline kerge maius valmib munavalgeid suhkruga vahustades ning seejärel kuivatades või küpsetades?
explanation_en: Meringue is a sweet foam made by whipping egg whites and sugar.
explanation_et: Besee on munavalgete ja suhkru vahustamisel saadud magus vaht.

category_name_en: Desserts from Oven, Fridge, and Fryer
clue_en: Which ridged sticks of fried dough are often rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with chocolate?
clue_et: Milliseid soonilisi praetud tainapulki veeretatakse sageli kaneelisuhkrus ja serveeritakse šokolaadiga?
explanation_en: Churros are piped lengths of dough fried until crisp and commonly dusted with sugar.
explanation_et: Tšurrod on pritsitud tainaribad, mis praetakse krõbedaks ja kaetakse sageli suhkruga.

category_name_en: Desserts from Oven, Fridge, and Fryer
clue_en: Which Italian dessert sets sweetened cream with gelatine and is served chilled?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia magustoit valmistatakse želatiiniga tardunud magusast koorest ja serveeritakse külmalt?
explanation_en: Panna cotta is sweetened cream set with gelatine in a mould or serving glass.
explanation_et: Panna cotta on vormis või serveerimisklaasis želatiiniga tardunud magus koor.

category_name_en: Desserts from Oven, Fridge, and Fryer
clue_en: Which small choux-pastry ball is filled with cream and often covered with chocolate sauce?
clue_et: Milline väike keedutainapall täidetakse koorekreemiga ja kaetakse sageli šokolaadikastmega?
explanation_en: A profiterole is a filled choux-pastry ball, commonly served with chocolate sauce.
explanation_et: Profitrool on täidetud keedutainapall, mida serveeritakse sageli šokolaadikastmega.

clue_en: Which crisp orchard fruit may be green, yellow, or red and grows on trees?
clue_et: Milline krõmpsuv puuvili kasvab puudel ning võib olla roheline, kollane või punane?
explanation_en: Apples are the fruits of cultivated trees in the genus Malus.
explanation_et: Õunad on perekonna Malus kultuurpuude viljad.

clue_en: What curved fruit usually has a yellow peel when ripe?
clue_et: Millisel kaardus puuviljal on küpsena tavaliselt kollane koor?
explanation_en: Bananas grow in hanging clusters and many dessert varieties develop a yellow peel as they ripen.
explanation_et: Banaanid kasvavad rippuvate kobaratena ning paljud dessertbanaanid muutuvad küpsedes kollaseks.

clue_en: Which citrus fruit shares its name with its usual colour and divides into juicy segments?
clue_et: Milline tsitrusvili kannab oma tavalise värvusega sama nime ning jaguneb mahlasteks sektoriteks?
explanation_en: The sweet orange is a segmented citrus fruit with an aromatic peel.
explanation_et: Magus apelsin on sektoriteks jagunev aromaatse koorega tsitrusvili.

clue_en: Which tropical fruit has rough diamond-patterned skin and a crown of stiff leaves?
clue_et: Millisel troopilisel viljal on kare rombimustriline koor ja jäikade lehtede kroon?
explanation_en: A pineapple develops from many flowers into one compound fruit topped by leaves.
explanation_et: Ananass areneb paljudest õitest üheks lehekrooniga liitviljaks.

clue_en: Which round fruit contains many jewel-like red seeds inside a tough rind?
clue_et: Milline ümar vili sisaldab kõva koore sees paljusid rubiinpunaseid seemnerüüsid?
explanation_en: A pomegranate encloses numerous juicy arils around its seeds.
explanation_et: Granaatõuna sees ümbritsevad arvukaid seemneid mahlased seemnerüüd.

clue_en: Which orange root vegetable is commonly grated into salads?
clue_et: Millist oranži juurvilja riivitakse sageli salatitesse?
explanation_en: The cultivated carrot is grown mainly for its enlarged edible taproot.
explanation_et: Kultuurporgandit kasvatatakse peamiselt jämenenud söödava peajuure pärast.

clue_en: Which pungent vegetable forms a bulb of tightly packed layers?
clue_et: Milline teravalõhnaline köögivili koosneb tihedalt pakitud lihakatest kihtidest?
explanation_en: The common onion stores nutrients in fleshy leaf bases that form its layered bulb.
explanation_et: Harilik sibul talletab toitaineid lihakates lehetuppedes, millest moodustub kihiline sibul.

clue_en: Which small root vegetable is usually red-skinned, white inside, crisp, and peppery?
clue_et: Milline väike juurvili on tavaliselt punase koorega, seest valge, krõmpsuv ja teravamaitseline?
explanation_en: Radishes are edible roots whose familiar red varieties have crisp white flesh and a peppery flavour.
explanation_et: Redised on söödavad juurviljad, mille tavalistel punastel sortidel on krõmpsuv valge sisu ja terav maitse.

clue_en: Which green vegetable is eaten as branching clusters of unopened flower buds?
clue_et: Millist rohelist köögivilja süüakse harunevate avanemata õiepungakobaratena?
explanation_en: A broccoli head consists mainly of immature flower clusters on thick stalks.
explanation_et: Brokolipea koosneb peamiselt jämedatel vartel paiknevatest ebaküpsetest õisikutest.

clue_en: Which vegetable consists of tender young spears harvested before they become fern-like?
clue_et: Milline köögivili koosneb õrnadest noortest võrsetest, mis korjatakse enne sõnajalataoliseks kasvamist?
explanation_en: Edible asparagus spears are young shoots cut before their branches unfold.
explanation_et: Söödavad sparglivarred on noored võrsed, mis lõigatakse enne harude avanemist.

clue_en: Which herb completes the lyric “parsley, sage, rosemary and ...” in Scarborough Fair?
clue_et: Milline maitsetaim lõpetab laulus „Scarborough Fair” rea „petersell, salvei, rosmariin ja ...”?
explanation_en: The traditional song lists parsley, sage, rosemary, and thyme, all familiar culinary herbs.
explanation_et: Rahvalaul loetleb peterselli, salvei, rosmariini ja tüümiani, mis kõik on tuntud maitsetaimed.

clue_en: What feathery herb commonly flavours pickles and fish dishes in northern Europe?
clue_et: Milline sulgjate lehtedega maitsetaim maitsestab Põhja-Euroopas sageli hapukurke ja kalaroogi?
explanation_en: Dill's leaves and seeds are aromatic and widely used in pickling and fish cookery.
explanation_et: Tilli aromaatseid lehti ja seemneid kasutatakse laialt marineerimisel ja kalaroogades.

clue_en: Which herb tastes cool because many varieties contain menthol?
clue_et: Milline maitsetaim tundub jahe, sest paljud sordid sisaldavad mentooli?
explanation_en: Menthol activates cold-sensitive receptors, giving mint its cooling sensation.
explanation_et: Mentool aktiveerib külmatundlikke retseptoreid ja annab mündile jahutava tunde.

clue_en: The fresh leaves called cilantro in North America come from which herb?
clue_et: Milliselt maitsetaimelt pärinevad värsked lehed, mida Põhja-Ameerikas nimetatakse cilantroks?
explanation_en: Cilantro and coriander leaves are names for the fresh foliage of Coriandrum sativum.
explanation_et: Cilantro ja koriandrilehed tähistavad taime Coriandrum sativum värskeid lehti.

clue_en: Which woody Mediterranean herb has narrow needle-like leaves and a piney aroma?
clue_et: Millisel puitunud Vahemere maitsetaimel on kitsad okkataolised lehed ja vaigune lõhn?
explanation_en: Rosemary is an evergreen aromatic shrub with narrow leaves used in cooking.
explanation_et: Rosmariin on igihaljas aromaatne kitsaste lehtedega põõsas, mida kasutatakse toiduvalmistamisel.

clue_en: Which sweet-smelling spice is made from the inner bark of trees?
clue_et: Milline magusalõhnaline vürts valmistatakse puude sisemisest koorest?
explanation_en: Cinnamon comes from dried inner bark of trees in the genus Cinnamomum.
explanation_et: Kaneeli saadakse perekonna Cinnamomum puude kuivatatud sisekoorest.

clue_en: Grinding dried peppercorns produces which common table spice?
clue_et: Milline tavaline lauavürts saadakse kuivatatud pipraterade jahvatamisel?
explanation_en: Black pepper is made from dried fruits of the pepper vine.
explanation_et: Must pipar valmistatakse piprataime kuivatatud viljadest.

clue_en: Which golden spice consists of dried stigmas from a crocus flower?
clue_et: Milline kuldne vürts koosneb krookuseõie kuivatatud emakasuudmetest?
explanation_en: Saffron threads are the hand-collected stigmas of the saffron crocus.
explanation_et: Safraniniidid on safrankrookuse käsitsi kogutud emakasuudmed.

clue_en: Which warm aromatic spice is a dried unopened flower bud?
clue_et: Milline soe aromaatne vürts on kuivatatud avanemata õiepung?
explanation_en: Culinary cloves are dried flower buds of the clove tree.
explanation_et: Toidunelk on nelgipuu kuivatatud õiepung.

clue_en: Which bright yellow spice comes from a rhizome related to ginger?
clue_et: Milline erkkollane vürts saadakse ingveriga suguluses oleva taime risoomist?
explanation_en: Turmeric powder is made from the dried rhizome of Curcuma longa.
explanation_et: Kurkumipulber valmistatakse Curcuma longa kuivatatud risoomist.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Breads of the World
clue_en: Which long, slender French loaf has a crisp crust?
clue_et: Milline pikk ja peenike Prantsuse sai on krõbeda koorikuga?
explanation_en: A baguette is a characteristically long French bread with a lean dough and crisp crust.
explanation_et: Baguette on iseloomulikult pikk vähese rasvaga tainast ja krõbeda koorikuga Prantsuse sai.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Breads of the World
clue_en: Which round Middle Eastern flatbread often opens into a pocket?
clue_et: Milline ümmargune Lähis-Ida lameleib avaneb sageli taskuks?
explanation_en: Steam can separate the layers of pita during baking and create a hollow pocket.
explanation_et: Küpsetamisel võib aur pita kihid lahutada ja moodustada õõnsa tasku.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Breads of the World
clue_en: What soft South Asian flatbread is traditionally baked against the wall of a tandoor?
clue_et: Milline pehme Lõuna-Aasia lameleib küpsetatakse traditsiooniliselt tandoori seinal?
explanation_en: Naan dough is stretched and slapped onto the hot inner wall of a tandoor oven.
explanation_et: Naani tainas venitatakse ja lüüakse küpsema tandoorahju kuumale siseseinale.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Breads of the World
clue_en: Which thin round bread is made from maize dough and forms the base of many tacos?
clue_et: Milline õhuke ümmargune leib tehakse maisitainast ja on paljude takode alus?
explanation_en: A corn tortilla is a flatbread made from treated maize dough called masa.
explanation_et: Maisitortilja on lameleib, mis valmistatakse töödeldud maisitainast ehk masast.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Breads of the World
clue_en: Which spongy fermented flatbread is used to scoop up stews in Ethiopia and Eritrea?
clue_et: Millise käsnja hapendatud lameleivaga süüakse Etioopias ja Eritreas hautisi?
explanation_en: Injera is a fermented, pancake-like flatbread served beneath and alongside stews.
explanation_et: Injera on hapendatud pannkoogilaadne lameleib, millele tõstetakse hautisi ja millega neid süüakse.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Cheeses of the World
clue_en: Which mild, stretchy cheese is the classic topping for pizza?
clue_et: Milline mahe ja veniv juust on klassikaline pitsakate?
explanation_en: Mozzarella melts smoothly and is central to many Italian pizzas.
explanation_et: Mozzarella sulab ühtlaselt ja on paljude Itaalia pitsade põhikoostisosa.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Cheeses of the World
clue_en: Which firm cheese named after an English village ranges from mild to mature?
clue_et: Milline Inglise küla järgi nime saanud kõva juust võib olla mahedast kuni laagerdununi?
explanation_en: Cheddar takes its name from the village of Cheddar in Somerset, England.
explanation_et: Cheddar sai nime Inglismaal Somersetis asuva Cheddari küla järgi.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Cheeses of the World
clue_en: Which crumbly white brined cheese is protected as a Greek product in the European Union?
clue_et: Milline murenev valge soolveejuust on Euroopa Liidus kaitstud Kreeka tootena?
explanation_en: EU-protected feta is a Greek brined cheese made from sheep's milk or a sheep-and-goat blend.
explanation_et: ELis kaitstud feta on Kreeka soolveejuust, mis on valmistatud lambapiimast või lamba- ja kitsepiima segust.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Cheeses of the World
clue_en: Which soft French cheese has a pale edible rind and creamy interior?
clue_et: Millisel pehmel Prantsuse juustul on hele söödav koorik ja kreemjas sisu?
explanation_en: Brie is a soft cow's-milk cheese ripened under a white mould rind.
explanation_et: Brie on pehme lehmapiimajuust, mis valmib valgehallituse kooriku all.

category_name_en: Food & Drink: Cheeses of the World
clue_en: Which Dutch cheese shares its name with a city in the Netherlands?
clue_et: Milline Hollandi juust kannab Madalmaade linna nime?
explanation_en: Gouda cheese is named for the Dutch city where it was historically traded.
explanation_et: Gouda juust sai nime Hollandi linna järgi, kus sellega ajalooliselt kaubeldi.

clue_en: Which pasta comes as long, thin cylindrical strands?
clue_et: Milline pasta koosneb pikkadest peenikestest silindrilistest niitidest?
explanation_en: Spaghetti is a long, solid, cylindrical form of pasta.
explanation_et: Spagetid on pikk, täis ja silindrikujuline pastaliik.

clue_en: What tube-shaped pasta has diagonal ends resembling a quill pen?
clue_et: Millise torukujulise pasta kaldus otsad meenutavad sulepead?
explanation_en: Penne is cut on the diagonal, and its name refers to pen nibs or quills.
explanation_et: Penne lõigatakse diagonaalselt ning selle nimi viitab sulepeale.

clue_en: Which pinched pasta shape resembles butterflies or bow ties?
clue_et: Milline keskelt kokku surutud pastakuju meenutab liblikaid või kikilipse?
explanation_en: Farfalle means butterflies in Italian and describes the pasta's winged shape.
explanation_et: Farfalle tähendab itaalia keeles liblikaid ja kirjeldab pasta tiivulist kuju.

clue_en: Which broad pasta sheets are layered with sauce and filling in a baked dish?
clue_et: Millised laiad pastaplaadid laotakse ahjuroas kastme ja täidisega kihiti?
explanation_en: Lasagne are wide pasta sheets used in the layered baked dish of the same name.
explanation_et: Lasanjeplaadid on laiad pastalehed, mida kasutatakse samanimelises kihilises ahjuroas.

clue_en: Which pasta consists of small dough parcels enclosing a filling?
clue_et: Milline pasta koosneb väikestest täidist ümbritsevatest tainapakkidest?
explanation_en: Ravioli seal fillings such as cheese, meat, or vegetables between thin pasta layers.
explanation_et: Ravioolides suletakse juustu-, liha- või köögiviljatäidis õhukeste pastakihtide vahele.

clue_en: Which familiar dish stir-fries cooked rice with ingredients such as vegetables, egg, or meat?
clue_et: Millises tuttavas roas praetakse keedetud riisi köögiviljade, muna või lihaga?
explanation_en: Fried rice is made by stir-frying cooked rice with seasonings and varied additions.
explanation_et: Praetud riisi valmistatakse keedetud riisi maitseainete ja mitmesuguste lisanditega pannil praadides.

clue_en: What sweet dish simmers rice with milk until soft and creamy?
clue_et: Milline magusroog valmib riisi piimas pehmeks ja kreemjaks keetes?
explanation_en: Rice pudding combines cooked rice with milk or cream and a sweetener.
explanation_et: Riisipudingis ühendatakse keedetud riis piima või koore ja magusainega.

clue_en: Which creamy Italian dish is made by gradually cooking rice with broth?
clue_et: Milline kreemjas Itaalia roog valmib riisi järk-järgult puljongiga keetes?
explanation_en: Risotto develops a creamy texture as short-grain rice releases starch into added broth.
explanation_et: Risoto saab kreemja tekstuuri, kui lühiteraline riis vabastab lisatud puljongisse tärklist.

clue_en: Which Valencian dish is cooked in a wide shallow pan, often with saffron?
clue_et: Milline Valencia roog valmib laial madalal pannil, sageli safraniga?
explanation_en: Paella is a Valencian rice dish named after the broad pan used to cook it.
explanation_et: Paella on Valencia riisiroog, mis sai nime selle küpsetamiseks kasutatava laia panni järgi.

clue_en: Which South Asian dish layers fragrant spiced rice with meat or vegetables?
clue_et: Millises Lõuna-Aasia roas laotakse lõhnav vürtsiriis kihiti liha või köögiviljadega?
explanation_en: Biryani combines seasoned rice with a separately prepared meat or vegetable component.
explanation_et: Biriyani ühendab maitsestatud riisi eraldi valmistatud liha- või köögiviljaosaga.

clue_en: Which red soup is based on cooked tomatoes?
clue_et: Millise punase supi aluseks on keedetud tomatid?
explanation_en: Tomato soup uses tomatoes as its primary ingredient and may be smooth or chunky.
explanation_et: Tomatisupi põhikoostisosa on tomat ning supp võib olla püree või tükkidega.

clue_en: Which soup tops caramelised onions and broth with bread and melted cheese?
clue_et: Millise supi karamellistatud sibulatele ja puljongile lisatakse sai ning sulatatud juust?
explanation_en: French onion soup combines deeply browned onions with stock and a gratinéed bread topping.
explanation_et: Prantsuse sibulasupp ühendab pruunistatud sibulad puljongi ja gratineeritud saiakattega.

clue_en: Which Japanese soup dissolves fermented soybean paste into dashi?
clue_et: Millises Jaapani supis lahustatakse kääritatud sojaoapasta dashi-puljongis?
explanation_en: Miso soup is prepared by mixing miso paste into a dashi-based broth.
explanation_et: Misosupp valmistatakse misopasta segamisel dashi-põhisesse puljongisse.

clue_en: Which eastern European soup is commonly coloured deep red by beetroot?
clue_et: Millise Ida-Euroopa supi värvib peet tavaliselt sügavpunaseks?
explanation_en: Many familiar forms of borscht use beetroot as the ingredient that gives the soup its red colour.
explanation_et: Paljudes tuntud boršivariantides annab supile punase värvuse peet.

clue_en: What chilled Andalusian soup blends raw tomatoes, peppers, cucumber, and olive oil?
clue_et: Milline külm Andaluusia supp segab toored tomatid, paprika, kurgi ja oliiviõli?
explanation_en: Gazpacho is served cold and is built from blended raw vegetables and olive oil.
explanation_et: Gazpachot serveeritakse külmalt ning see valmistatakse püreestatud toorestest köögiviljadest ja oliiviõlist.

clue_en: Which salad combines romaine lettuce, croutons, Parmesan, and a savoury dressing?
clue_et: Milline salat ühendab rooma salati, krutoonid, parmesani ja maitseküllase kastme?
explanation_en: A classic Caesar salad is based on dressed romaine leaves, croutons, and Parmesan.
explanation_et: Klassikalise Caesari salati aluseks on kastmega rooma salat, krutoonid ja parmesan.

clue_en: Which salad typically includes tomato, cucumber, olives, and feta?
clue_et: Milline salat sisaldab tavaliselt tomatit, kurki, oliive ja fetat?
explanation_en: Greek salad, or horiatiki, combines fresh vegetables with olives and feta.
explanation_et: Kreeka salat ehk horiatiki ühendab värsked köögiviljad oliivide ja fetaga.

clue_en: What crunchy salad is made mainly from finely shredded raw cabbage?
clue_et: Milline krõmpsuv salat valmistatakse peamiselt peeneks ribastatud toorest kapsast?
explanation_en: Coleslaw dresses shredded cabbage, often together with carrot.
explanation_et: Kapsasalati valmistamisel segatakse ribastatud kapsas kastmega, sageli koos porgandiga.

clue_en: Which simple salad layers tomato, fresh mozzarella, and basil?
clue_et: Millises lihtsas salatis laotakse kihiti tomat, värske mozzarella ja basiilik?
explanation_en: Caprese salad pairs tomatoes and mozzarella with fresh basil and olive oil.
explanation_et: Caprese salat ühendab tomati ja mozzarella värske basiiliku ning oliiviõliga.

clue_en: Which salad traditionally mixes apples, celery, and walnuts in a creamy dressing?
clue_et: Millises salatis segatakse traditsiooniliselt õunad, seller ja Kreeka pähklid kreemja kastmega?
explanation_en: The familiar Waldorf combination includes apple, celery, walnuts, and mayonnaise.
explanation_et: Tuntud Waldorfi kombinatsiooni kuuluvad õun, seller, Kreeka pähklid ja majonees.

clue_en: Which warm bowl is made by simmering oats or another grain in water or milk?
clue_et: Milline soe roog valmib kaerahelveste või muu teravilja keetmisel vees või piimas?
explanation_en: Porridge is a soft cereal dish produced by boiling grain in liquid.
explanation_et: Puder on pehme teraviljaroog, mis saadakse terade või helveste keetmisel vedelikus.

clue_en: Which breakfast cake is cooked between patterned plates that give it a grid of square pockets?
clue_et: Milline hommikuküpsetis valmib mustriliste plaatide vahel, mis jätavad sellele ruudukujuliste süvendite võrgustiku?
explanation_en: A waffle iron presses batter into a crisp cake with a distinctive grid pattern.
explanation_et: Vahvliküpsetaja pressib taina krõbedaks iseloomuliku ruudumustriga küpsetiseks.

clue_en: Which crescent-shaped pastry gets flaky layers from repeatedly folding butter into dough?
clue_et: Milline poolkuukujuline küpsetis saab helbelised kihid võikihi korduva tainasse voltimise tulemusel?
explanation_en: Croissant dough is laminated with butter, creating airy layers during baking.
explanation_et: Sarvesaia tainas lamineeritakse võiga, mis tekitab küpsedes õhulised kihid.

clue_en: Which uncooked cereal blend usually contains rolled oats, nuts, seeds, and dried fruit?
clue_et: Milline kuumtöötlemata teraviljasegu sisaldab tavaliselt kaerahelbeid, pähkleid, seemneid ja kuivatatud puuvilju?
explanation_en: Muesli is a loose mixture of grains and additions served with milk, yoghurt, or fruit.
explanation_et: Müsli on teravilja ja lisandite segu, mida süüakse piima, jogurti või puuviljadega.

clue_en: Which brunch dish places poached eggs and hollandaise on split English muffins?
clue_et: Millises hilise hommikusöögi roas pannakse pošeeritud munad ja Hollandi kaste poolitatud Inglise muffinitele?
explanation_en: Eggs Benedict combines toasted muffin halves, a savoury layer, poached eggs, and hollandaise.
explanation_et: Benedicti munad ühendavad röstitud muffinipooled, soolase lisandi, pošeeritud munad ja Hollandi kastme.

clue_en: Which layered Italian dessert combines coffee-soaked biscuits with mascarpone cream?
clue_et: Milline kihiline Itaalia magustoit ühendab kohvis immutatud küpsised mascarpone-kreemiga?
explanation_en: Tiramisu layers coffee-dipped ladyfingers with a mascarpone-based mixture.
explanation_et: Tiramisu laotakse kihiti kohvis immutatud Savoiardi küpsistest ja mascarpone-segust.

clue_en: Which custard dessert is finished with a brittle layer of caramelised sugar?
clue_et: Millise keedukreemimagustoidu peal on habras karamellistatud suhkru kiht?
explanation_en: Crème brûlée contrasts a chilled custard base with a hard caramel top.
explanation_et: Crème brûlée ühendab jahutatud keedukreemi kõva karamellikattega.

clue_en: Which baked pie encloses slices of the fruit the queen gives Snow White, often seasoned with cinnamon?
clue_et: Milline küpsetatud pirukas sisaldab viile viljast, mille kuninganna annab Lumivalgekesele, ning mida maitsestatakse sageli kaneeliga?
explanation_en: Apple pie surrounds seasoned apple pieces with pastry, often above and below.
explanation_et: Õunapirukas ümbritseb maitsestatud õunatükid tainaga, sageli nii alt kui ka pealt.

clue_en: What rich cake has a filling based on soft fresh cheese over a crust?
clue_et: Millise rikkaliku koogi täidis põhineb krõbedal põhjal oleval pehmel toorjuustul?
explanation_en: Cheesecake uses a sweetened soft-cheese filling set over a pastry or crumb base.
explanation_et: Juustukoogis on taina- või küpsisepõhjal magus pehme juustu täidis.

clue_en: Which pastry layers thin filo with chopped nuts and sweet syrup?
clue_et: Millises küpsetises vahelduvad õhuke filotainas, hakitud pähklid ja magus siirup?
explanation_en: Baklava is assembled from many filo layers, a nut filling, and syrup or honey.
explanation_et: Baklava koosneb paljudest filotainakihtidest, pähklitäidisest ja siirupist või meest.

clue_en: What smooth mixture of chocolate and warm cream is used as a cake filling, glaze, or truffle centre?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse šokolaadi ja sooja koore siledat segu, mida kasutatakse koogitäidise, glasuuri või trühvlisisuna?
explanation_en: Ganache forms when chopped chocolate melts into warm cream and the mixture becomes a smooth emulsion.
explanation_et: Ganache valmib, kui hakitud šokolaad sulab soojas koores ja moodustab sileda emulsiooni.

clue_en: What pale edible fat is pressed from cacao beans?
clue_et: Milline hele söödav rasv pressitakse kakaoubadest?
explanation_en: Cocoa butter is the natural fat separated from cacao beans.
explanation_et: Kakaovõi on kakaoubadest eraldatud looduslik rasv.

clue_en: Which variety usually contains cocoa solids and sugar but no added milk solids?
clue_et: Milline sort sisaldab tavaliselt kakaokuivainet ja suhkrut, kuid mitte lisatud piimakuivainet?
explanation_en: Dark chocolate is based on cocoa solids and cocoa butter with sugar, without the milk component of milk chocolate.
explanation_et: Tume šokolaad põhineb kakaokuivainel, kakaovõil ja suhkrul ilma piimašokolaadi piimakomponendita.

clue_en: Which pale confection uses cocoa butter, sugar, and milk but lacks cocoa solids?
clue_et: Milline hele maius sisaldab kakaovõid, suhkrut ja piima, kuid mitte kakaokuivainet?
explanation_en: White chocolate contains cocoa butter but not the dark cocoa particles found in other varieties.
explanation_et: Valge šokolaad sisaldab kakaovõid, kuid mitte teistele sortidele värvi andvaid kakaoosakesi.

clue_en: What controlled heating and cooling process gives a finished bar a glossy surface and clean snap?
clue_et: Milline kontrollitud kuumutamise ja jahutamise protsess annab tahvlile läike ja selge murdumise?
explanation_en: Tempering encourages stable cocoa-butter crystals that create shine and a firm texture.
explanation_et: Tempereerimine soodustab stabiilsete kakaovõikristallide teket, mis annavad läike ja tugeva tekstuuri.

clue_en: What Italian frozen dessert is churned into a dense, smooth texture?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia külmutatud magustoit valmistatakse tiheda ja sileda tekstuuriga?
explanation_en: Gelato is the Italian style of churned frozen dairy dessert.
explanation_et: Gelato on Itaalia stiilis segades külmutatud piimamagustoit.

clue_en: Which frozen dessert is based on sweetened fruit or juice and normally contains no dairy?
clue_et: Milline külmutatud magustoit põhineb magustatud puuviljal või mahlal ega sisalda tavaliselt piimatooteid?
explanation_en: Sorbet freezes fruit purée or juice with sugar and water rather than milk or cream.
explanation_et: Sorbett külmutab puuviljapüree või mahla suhkru ja veega, mitte piima või koorega.

clue_en: Which ice-cream dessert serves scoops under sauce and often nuts, fruit, or whipped cream?
clue_et: Millises jäätisemagustoidus kaetakse jäätisepallid kastme ning sageli pähklite, puuviljade või vahukoorega?
explanation_en: A sundae is a dish of frozen scoops dressed with sweet toppings.
explanation_et: Sundae on jäätisepallidest magustoit, mida kaunistatakse magusate lisanditega.

clue_en: Pods from which orchid provide the familiar speckled flavouring for many frozen desserts?
clue_et: Millise orhidee kupardest saadakse paljude külmutatud magustoitude tuttav täpiline maitseaine?
explanation_en: Vanilla flavour comes from cured seed pods of orchids in the genus Vanilla.
explanation_et: Vanillimaitse saadakse perekonna Vanilla orhideede töödeldud seemnekupardest.

clue_en: What continuous mixing action limits large ice crystals while a frozen dessert freezes?
clue_et: Milline pidev segamisliigutus piirab külmutamise ajal suurte jääkristallide teket?
explanation_en: Churning keeps the mixture moving, breaks up ice crystals, and incorporates air.
explanation_et: Kloppimine hoiab segu liikumises, lõhub jääkristalle ja seob õhku.

clue_en: Which coffee maker uses a mesh plunger to press the grounds to the bottom before pouring?
clue_et: Millises kohvivalmistajas surutakse kohvipuru enne valamist võrk-kolviga anuma põhja?
explanation_en: A French press steeps coarse grounds in hot water and then separates them with a plunger-mounted filter.
explanation_et: Presskannus tõmmatakse jämedat kohvipuru kuumas vees ning eraldatakse see kolvi küljes oleva filtriga.

clue_en: Which café drink combines espresso with steamed milk and a cap of milk foam?
clue_et: Milline kohvikujook ühendab espresso aurutatud piima ja piimavahumütsiga?
explanation_en: A cappuccino is built from espresso and textured milk with a distinct foamed top.
explanation_et: Cappuccino koosneb espressost ja tekstureeritud piimast ning sellel on selge vahukiht.

clue_en: What milky café drink adds a generous amount of steamed milk to espresso?
clue_et: Millises piimases kohvikujoogis lisatakse espressole rohkelt aurutatud piima?
explanation_en: Caffè latte means coffee with milk and combines espresso with a larger milk component.
explanation_et: Caffè latte tähendab piimaga kohvi ning ühendab espresso suurema koguse piimaga.

clue_en: Which drink is made by diluting espresso with hot water?
clue_et: Milline jook valmistatakse espresso lahjendamisel kuuma veega?
explanation_en: Adding hot water to espresso produces the longer drink known as an Americano.
explanation_et: Kuuma vee lisamisel espressole saadakse pikem jook americano.

clue_en: The roasted “bean” used for brewing is actually the seed of what plant fruit?
clue_et: Röstitud „uba”, millest jooki valmistatakse, on tegelikult millise taime vilja seeme?
explanation_en: Coffee beans are seeds found inside the fruit commonly called a coffee cherry.
explanation_et: Kohvioad on seemned, mis asuvad kohvikirsiks nimetatava vilja sees.

clue_en: Which dark infusion is made from leaves allowed to oxidise fully before drying?
clue_et: Milline tume tõmmis valmistatakse lehtedest, millel lastakse enne kuivatamist täielikult oksüdeeruda?
explanation_en: Black-tea processing allows substantial leaf oxidation, creating its darker colour and flavour.
explanation_et: Musta tee töötlemisel lastakse lehtedel tugevalt oksüdeeruda, mis annab tumedama värvi ja maitse.

clue_en: Which infusion keeps a fresher colour because its leaves are heated soon after picking?
clue_et: Milline tõmmis säilitab värskema värvuse, sest selle lehti kuumutatakse peagi pärast korjamist?
explanation_en: Early heating stops most oxidation in green-tea leaves.
explanation_et: Varajane kuumutamine peatab rohelise tee lehtedes suurema osa oksüdeerumisest.

clue_en: What name is often given to a hot infusion of herbs or flowers that contains no Camellia sinensis leaves?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse sageli ürtide või õite kuuma tõmmist, mis ei sisalda teepõõsa lehti?
explanation_en: Herbal teas are infusions of plants other than the tea plant.
explanation_et: Taimeteed on muude taimede, mitte teepõõsa tõmmised.

clue_en: Which traditional Chinese style is partly oxidised, between green and black varieties?
clue_et: Milline traditsiooniline Hiina teesort on osaliselt oksüdeeritud ning jääb rohelise ja musta vahele?
explanation_en: Oolong processing uses controlled partial oxidation to create a wide range of aromas.
explanation_et: Oolongi valmistamisel kasutatakse kontrollitud osalist oksüdeerimist, mis loob laia aroomivaliku.

clue_en: Which Japanese style whisks finely powdered green leaves directly into water?
clue_et: Millise Jaapani teesordi puhul vispeldatakse peeneks jahvatatud rohelised lehed otse vette?
explanation_en: With matcha, shade-grown leaves are ground and consumed as part of the drink.
explanation_et: Matcha puhul jahvatatakse varjus kasvatatud lehed pulbriks ning tarvitatakse joogi osana.

clue_en: Which tropical juice comes from a rough-skinned fruit topped by a crown of stiff leaves?
clue_et: Milline troopiline mahl saadakse krobelise koore ja jäikadest lehtedest krooniga viljast?
explanation_en: Pineapple juice is pressed from the sweet flesh of the tropical pineapple fruit.
explanation_et: Ananassimahl pressitakse troopilise ananassi magusast viljalihast.

clue_en: What clear or cloudy juice is pressed from the fruit that, according to legend, fell near Isaac Newton?
clue_et: Milline selge või hägune mahl pressitakse viljast, mis pärimuse järgi kukkus Isaac Newtoni lähedal?
explanation_en: Apple juice is extracted by crushing and pressing apples, then often filtering or pasteurising it.
explanation_et: Õunamahl saadakse õunte purustamise ja pressimisega ning seda sageli filtreeritakse või pastöriseeritakse.

clue_en: Which savoury red drink is the classic non-alcoholic base of a Bloody Mary?
clue_et: Milline soolakas punane mahl on Bloody Mary klassikaline alkoholivaba alus?
explanation_en: Tomato juice preserves the fruit's pulp and savoury flavour in drinkable form.
explanation_et: Tomatimahl säilitab vilja viljaliha ja soolaka maitse joodaval kujul.

clue_en: Which tart red drink comes from berries that grow on low evergreen vines in boggy ground?
clue_et: Milline hapukas punane jook pärineb madalatel igihaljastel vartel soises pinnases kasvavatest marjadest?
explanation_en: Cranberries are tart wetland berries whose juice is commonly blended or sweetened.
explanation_et: Jõhvikad on hapud märgalamarjad, mille mahla sageli segatakse või magustatakse.

clue_en: Which juice is pressed from the large citrus fruit named for the grape-like clusters in which it grows?
clue_et: Millist mahla pressitakse suurest tsitrusviljast, mis sai nime viinamarjakobaraid meenutava kasvukuju järgi?
explanation_en: Grapefruits grow in clusters and produce a juice with both sharp acidity and bitter compounds.
explanation_et: Greibid kasvavad kobaratena ning annavad mahla, milles on nii teravat happesust kui ka mõruaineid.

clue_en: Which looped-wire tool beats eggs and incorporates air into mixtures?
clue_et: Milline traatsilmustest tööriist klopib mune ja segab massi õhku?
explanation_en: A whisk's loops move rapidly through liquid to blend it and trap air bubbles.
explanation_et: Vispli aasad liiguvad kiiresti läbi vedeliku, segades seda ja püüdes õhumulle.

clue_en: What perforated tool shreds cheese or vegetables against sharp-edged holes?
clue_et: Milline teravaservaliste avadega tööriist peenestab juustu või köögivilju?
explanation_en: Food rubbed across a grater's cutting holes is reduced to small shreds.
explanation_et: Riivi lõikeavade vastu hõõrutud toit muutub väikesteks ribadeks.

clue_en: Which handheld blade removes thin strips of skin from potatoes or carrots?
clue_et: Milline käes hoitav tera eemaldab kartulilt või porgandilt õhukesi kooreribasid?
explanation_en: A peeler cuts away a thin surface layer while following the shape of produce.
explanation_et: Koorija lõikab köögivilja kuju järgides ära õhukese pinnakihi.

clue_en: Which perforated bowl drains water from pasta?
clue_et: Milline aukudega kauss kurnab pasta keeduveest?
explanation_en: A colander retains solid food while liquid escapes through its holes.
explanation_et: Sõel hoiab tahke toidu sees, samal ajal kui vedelik voolab avadest välja.

clue_en: Which two-piece tool crushes spices in a bowl using a heavy club-shaped grinder?
clue_et: Milline kaheosaline tööriist purustab vürtse kausis raske nuiakujulise tambitsaga?
explanation_en: The pestle presses and grinds ingredients against the hard interior of the mortar.
explanation_et: Nui surub ja hõõrub koostisosad vastu uhmri kõva sisepinda.

clue_en: What method cooks food submerged in liquid kept at its bubbling point?
clue_et: Milline meetod küpsetab toitu mullitaval temperatuuril hoitavas vedelikus?
explanation_en: Boiling transfers heat from vigorously moving hot liquid into the food.
explanation_et: Keetmisel kandub kuumus hoogsalt liikuva kuuma vedeliku kaudu toitu.

clue_en: Which gentle method cooks food with hot water vapour rather than immersing it?
clue_et: Milline õrn meetod küpsetab toitu kuuma veeauruga, mitte vedelikku uputades?
explanation_en: Steam condenses on the food and transfers heat without the food sitting in water.
explanation_et: Aur kondenseerub toidul ja annab soojust üle ilma toitu vette asetamata.

clue_en: What method quickly cooks small pieces in a hot pan with a little fat?
clue_et: Milline meetod küpsetab väikseid tükke kiiresti kuumal pannil vähese rasvaga?
explanation_en: Sautéing uses high direct heat, a shallow pan, and a small amount of fat.
explanation_et: Praadimine kasutab tugevat otsest kuumust, madalat panni ja vähest rasva.

clue_en: Which dry-heat method browns food in an oven or near an open heat source?
clue_et: Milline kuiva kuumuse meetod pruunistab toitu ahjus või lahtise kuumusallika lähedal?
explanation_en: Roasting surrounds food with dry heat that promotes browning at the surface.
explanation_et: Röstimisel ümbritseb toitu kuiv kuumus, mis soodustab pinna pruunistumist.

clue_en: Which method gently cooks eggs or fish in liquid kept below a full boil?
clue_et: Milline meetod küpsetab mune või kala õrnalt vedelikus, mida ei lasta täie hooga keema?
explanation_en: Poaching uses relatively calm hot liquid to cook delicate food without vigorous bubbling.
explanation_et: Pošeerimine kasutab õrna toidu küpsetamiseks rahulikku kuuma vedelikku ilma tugeva mullitamiseta.

clue_en: Which living microorganism makes bread dough rise by releasing carbon dioxide?
clue_et: Milline elus mikroorganism kergitab leivatainast süsihappegaasi eraldades?
explanation_en: Baker's yeast ferments sugars in dough and fills it with carbon-dioxide bubbles.
explanation_et: Pagaripärm kääritab tainas suhkruid ja täidab selle süsihappegaasimullidega.

clue_en: Which ready-mixed leavener contains both a base and dry acid?
clue_et: Milline valmis kergitusaine sisaldab nii alust kui ka kuiva hapet?
explanation_en: Moisture activates baking powder's acid-base reaction and releases carbon dioxide.
explanation_et: Niiskus käivitab küpsetuspulbri happe-aluse reaktsiooni ning vabastab süsihappegaasi.

clue_en: What repeated folding and pressing develops the elastic network in wheat dough?
clue_et: Milline korduv voltimine ja surumine arendab nisutainas elastset võrgustikku?
explanation_en: Kneading aligns and strengthens gluten proteins so dough can trap gas.
explanation_et: Sõtkumine joondab ja tugevdab gluteenivalke, et tainas suudaks gaasi kinni hoida.

clue_en: What resting stage lets a shaped yeast dough expand before it goes into the oven?
clue_et: Milline puhke-etapp laseb vormitud pärmitainal enne ahju panemist kerkida?
explanation_en: During proofing, fermentation continues and gas expands the dough's structure.
explanation_et: Järelkergitamisel jätkub käärimine ning gaas paisutab taina struktuuri.

clue_en: What technique prebakes a pie crust without its filling?
clue_et: Millise võttega eelküpsetatakse pirukapõhi ilma täidiseta?
explanation_en: Blind baking sets and browns pastry before a wet or unbaked filling is added.
explanation_et: Pimeküpsetamine kinnistab ja pruunistab taina enne märja või küpsetamata täidise lisamist.

clue_en: Which classic pizza is topped in the colours of tomato, mozzarella, and basil?
clue_et: Millise klassikalise pitsa katte moodustavad tomati, mozzarella ja basiiliku värvid?
explanation_en: Pizza Margherita uses tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil as its signature toppings.
explanation_et: Margherita pitsa tunnuskate koosneb tomatist, mozzarellast ja värskest basiilikust.

clue_en: What green Ligurian sauce blends basil with garlic, pine nuts, hard cheese, and olive oil?
clue_et: Milline roheline Liguuria kaste segab basiiliku küüslaugu, seedermänniseemnete, kõva juustu ja oliiviõliga?
explanation_en: Pesto alla genovese is pounded or blended from fresh basil and its traditional partners.
explanation_et: Pesto alla genovese uhmerdatakse või segatakse värskest basiilikust ja selle klassikalistest lisanditest.

clue_en: Which small Italian dumplings are often made from potato and flour?
clue_et: Millised väikesed Itaalia klimbid valmistatakse sageli kartulist ja jahust?
explanation_en: Potato gnocchi combine cooked potato with enough flour to form tender dumplings.
explanation_et: Kartuli-gnocchi ühendab keedukartuli piisava jahuga, et vormida õrnad klimbid.

clue_en: Which northern Italian staple cooks maize meal into a soft porridge or firm slices?
clue_et: Milline Põhja-Itaalia põhitoit keedab maisijahu pehmeks pudruks või tahketeks viiludeks?
explanation_en: Polenta is cooked maize meal that can be served soft or cooled until firm.
explanation_et: Polenta on keedetud maisijahu, mida serveeritakse pehmelt või jahutatakse tahkeks.

clue_en: Which simple dessert pours a shot of hot espresso over a scoop of gelato?
clue_et: Millises lihtsas magustoidus valatakse kuum espresso gelato-pallile?
explanation_en: Affogato al caffè pairs cold gelato with freshly poured espresso.
explanation_et: Affogato al caffè ühendab külma gelato värskelt valatud espressoga.

clue_en: Which handheld dish folds a tortilla around a savoury filling?
clue_et: Millises käes söödavas roas volditakse tortilja soolase täidise ümber?
explanation_en: A taco uses a small tortilla to hold meat, vegetables, salsa, or other fillings.
explanation_et: Takos hoiab väike tortilja liha-, köögivilja-, salsa- või muud täidist.

clue_en: What green dip is mashed primarily from ripe avocados?
clue_et: Milline roheline dipikaste valmistatakse peamiselt küpsetest avokaadodest?
explanation_en: Guacamole combines mashed avocado with seasonings such as lime, chilli, onion, or coriander.
explanation_et: Guacamole ühendab tambitud avokaado laimi, tšilli, sibula, koriandri või muude maitseainetega.

clue_en: Which broad name covers Mexican sauces often made from tomato or tomatillo with chilli?
clue_et: Milline üldnimetus hõlmab Mehhiko kastmeid, mida valmistatakse sageli tomatist või tomatillost ja tšillist?
explanation_en: Salsa simply means sauce in Spanish and includes many fresh and cooked Mexican varieties.
explanation_et: Salsa tähendab hispaania keeles kastet ning hõlmab paljusid värskeid ja kuumtöödeldud Mehhiko variante.

clue_en: Which dish steams seasoned masa and filling inside a corn husk or banana leaf?
clue_et: Millises roas aurutatakse maitsestatud masa ja täidis maisilehes või banaanilehes?
explanation_en: A tamal is a parcel of maize dough steamed in a leaf wrapper.
explanation_et: Tamal on leheümbrises aurutatud maisitainapakike.

clue_en: What name describes complex Mexican sauces built from chillies, spices, and sometimes nuts or cacao?
clue_et: Milline nimi tähistab keerukaid Mehhiko kastmeid, mille aluseks on tšillid, vürtsid ning vahel pähklid või kakao?
explanation_en: Mole is a family of richly seasoned sauces rather than one fixed recipe.
explanation_et: Mole on rikkalikult maitsestatud kastmete perekond, mitte üks kindel retsept.

clue_en: Which Japanese speciality is centred on seasoned vinegared rice rather than necessarily raw fish?
clue_et: Millise Jaapani toidu keskmes on maitsestatud äädikriis, mitte tingimata toores kala?
explanation_en: The defining element of sushi is vinegared rice combined with toppings, fillings, or seaweed.
explanation_et: Sushi määrav osa on äädikriis, mida ühendatakse katete, täidiste või merevetikaga.

clue_en: What dish serves carefully sliced raw seafood without a bed of vinegared rice?
clue_et: Millises roas serveeritakse hoolikalt viilutatud toorest mereandi ilma äädikriisi aluseta?
explanation_en: Sashimi consists of sliced raw fish or other seafood served on its own with garnishes.
explanation_et: Sashimi koosneb viilutatud toorest kalast või muust mereannist, mida serveeritakse lisanditega ilma riisita.

clue_en: Which cooking style coats seafood or vegetables in a light batter before frying?
clue_et: Millises valmistusviisis kaetakse mereannid või köögiviljad enne praadimist kerge tainaga?
explanation_en: Tempura uses a thin batter and hot oil to create a light, crisp coating.
explanation_et: Tempura kasutab õhukest tainast ja kuuma õli, et tekitada kerge krõbe kate.

clue_en: Which savoury paste is produced by fermenting soybeans with kōji?
clue_et: Milline soolakas pasta saadakse sojaubade kääritamisel kōji abil?
explanation_en: Miso fermentation combines soybeans, salt, and kōji culture into an umami-rich paste.
explanation_et: Miso kääritamisel saavad sojaubadest, soolast ja kōji-kultuurist umamirikas pasta.

clue_en: Which noodle dish places wheat noodles in broth with varied toppings?
clue_et: Millises nuudliroas pannakse nisunuudlid puljongisse koos mitmesuguste lisanditega?
explanation_en: Ramen combines Chinese-style wheat noodles with seasoned broth and toppings.
explanation_et: Ramen ühendab Hiina stiilis nisunuudlid maitsestatud puljongi ja lisanditega.

clue_en: Which rolled sweet bun is flavoured with cinnamon and is popular across Nordic bakeries?
clue_et: Milline kaneeliga maitsestatud rullis magus sai on populaarne Põhjamaade pagarikodades?
explanation_en: Cinnamon buns are rolled around a cinnamon filling and are a familiar Nordic bakery treat.
explanation_et: Kaneelisaiad keeratakse kaneelitäidise ümber rulli ning need on Põhjamaades tuttav pagaritoode.

clue_en: Which familiar Swedish dish serves small meatballs with gravy and often lingonberry jam?
clue_et: Millises tuntud Rootsi roas serveeritakse väikseid lihapalle kastme ja sageli pohlamoosiga?
explanation_en: Swedish meatballs are commonly served with cream gravy, potatoes, and lingonberry jam.
explanation_et: Rootsi lihapalle serveeritakse sageli koorekastme, kartulite ja pohlamoosiga.

clue_en: Which thick Icelandic cultured dairy food resembles strained yoghurt?
clue_et: Milline paks Islandi hapendatud piimatoode meenutab kurnatud jogurtit?
explanation_en: Skyr is cultured from milk and strained into a thick fresh dairy product.
explanation_et: Skyr hapendatakse piimast ja kurnatakse paksuks värskeks piimatooteks.

clue_en: Which Nordic preparation cures salmon with salt, sugar, and dill?
clue_et: Millises Põhjamaade roas soolatakse lõhet soola, suhkru ja tilliga?
explanation_en: Gravlax is salmon cured without smoking in a mixture typically flavoured with dill.
explanation_et: Graavilõhe on suitsutamata lõhe, mida soolatakse tavaliselt tilliga maitsestatud segus.

clue_en: Which creamy Finnish soup combines salmon with potatoes and dill?
clue_et: Milline kreemjas Soome supp ühendab lõhe kartulite ja tilliga?
explanation_en: Finnish salmon soup, or lohikeitto, cooks salmon and potatoes in a creamy broth flavoured with dill.
explanation_et: Soome lõhesupis küpsevad lõhe ja kartulid tilliga maitsestatud kooreses leemes.

clue_en: What Estonian roasted flour mixture is stirred into kefir, yoghurt, or sour milk?
clue_et: Milline Eesti röstitud jahusegu segatakse keefiri, jogurti või hapupiima sisse?
explanation_en: Kama is a ready-to-eat blend of roasted grain and pea flours used in quick dairy desserts.
explanation_et: Kama on röstitud tera- ja hernejahude valmissegu, mida kasutatakse kiiretes piimamagustoitudes.

clue_en: Which dark, tangy loaf is a daily staple across Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania?
clue_et: Milline tume hapukas leib on igapäevane põhitoit Eestis, Lätis ja Leedus?
explanation_en: Dense sourdough rye breads are central to the food traditions of all three Baltic countries.
explanation_et: Tihedad juuretisega rukkileivad on kõigi kolme Balti riigi toidutraditsioonide keskmes.

clue_en: What chocolate-coated dairy sweet with a pressed-curd centre is familiar across the Baltic countries?
clue_et: Milline magusa kohupiimasisu ja šokolaadiglasuuriga piimamaius on tuttav kõigis Balti riikides?
explanation_en: The Baltic curd snack combines a sweet pressed-curd centre with a thin confectionery coating.
explanation_et: Balti kohuke ühendab magusa pressitud kohupiimasisu õhukese glasuurkattega.

clue_en: Which bright pink Lithuanian cold soup combines beetroot with kefir or soured milk?
clue_et: Milline erkroosa Leedu külmsupp ühendab peedi keefiri või hapupiimaga?
explanation_en: Šaltibarščiai is served cold and gets its pink colour when beetroot is mixed with cultured dairy.
explanation_et: Šaltibarščiaid serveeritakse külmalt ning selle roosa värv tekib peedi segamisel hapendatud piimatootega.

clue_en: Which Latvian dish pairs local grey peas with fried onion and bacon?
clue_et: Millises Läti roas ühendatakse kohalikud hallid herned praetud sibula ja peekoniga?
accepted_variants_en: Latvian grey peas;pelēkie zirņi ar speķi
accepted_variants_et: Läti hallid herned;pelēkie zirņi ar speķi
explanation_en: Grey peas with bacon and onion are a traditional Latvian hot dish.
explanation_et: Hallid herned peekoni ja sibulaga on traditsiooniline Läti soe roog.

clue_en: This Italian egg dish begins in a frying pan and is often finished under a grill; unlike a folded omelette, its fillings are mixed through the eggs. Name it.
clue_et: See Itaalia munaroog alustab küpsemist pannil ja valmib sageli grilli all; erinevalt kokkuvolditud omletist on täidis munasegusse läbi segatud. Mis roog see on?
explanation_en: A frittata cooks its eggs and fillings together as a thick, open-faced dish, often with the top set under direct heat.
explanation_et: Frittata puhul küpsevad munad ja täidis koos paksuks lahtiseks roaks ning pealispind lastakse sageli otsese kuumuse all hüübida.

clue_en: Which French savoury tart sets eggs and cream inside a pastry crust, with bacon appearing in its Lorraine version?
clue_et: Milline Prantsuse soolane pirukas hüübib tainapõhjas muna ja koore segust ning sisaldab Lorraine'i versioonis peekonit?
explanation_en: Quiche is an open pastry case with a savoury egg-and-dairy filling; quiche Lorraine traditionally adds lardons or bacon.
explanation_et: Quiche on lahtine soolane pirukas muna-piimatäidisega; quiche Lorraine'i traditsioonilisse täidisesse kuuluvad peekonitükid.

clue_en: At tapas bars, thick round slices made chiefly from eggs, potatoes, and onion belong to which classic dish?
clue_et: Millise klassikalise roa paksud ümmargused viilud valmivad tapasebaarides peamiselt munast, kartulist ja sibulast?
explanation_en: Tortilla española slowly sets eggs around fried potatoes and often onion, producing a thick cake cut into wedges.
explanation_et: Tortilla española puhul hüübib muna aeglaselt praetud kartuli ja sageli ka sibula ümber ning paks roog lõigatakse sektoriteks.

clue_en: In Japan, dashi, shiitake mushrooms, and boiled shrimp can be suspended in a silky savoury egg mixture steamed and eaten from a small cup. Name the dish.
clue_et: Jaapanis aurutatakse dashi, shiitake-seente ja keedetud krevettidega siidiseks soolane munasegu, mida süüakse väikesest tassist. Mis roog see on?
explanation_en: Chawanmushi means 'steamed in a tea bowl' and differs from sweet custards through its dashi-based savoury filling.
explanation_et: Chawanmushi nimi tähendab teekausis aurutamist ning magusast kreemist eristab seda dashi-põhine soolane täidis.

clue_en: Which Turkish pan dish combines softly set eggs with tomatoes and green peppers and is commonly served in the vessel in which it cooked?
clue_et: Milline Türgi panniroog ühendab pehmelt hüübinud munad tomati ja rohelise paprikaga ning tuuakse sageli lauale küpsetusnõus?
explanation_en: Menemen cooks eggs with tomatoes, peppers, and seasonings into a soft mixture intended for sharing with bread.
explanation_et: Menemenis küpsevad munad tomati, paprika ja maitseainetega pehmeks seguks, mida jagatakse tavaliselt leiva kõrvale.

clue_en: Which small Russian and Siberian dumplings wrap seasoned raw meat in thin dough and are often served with butter or sour cream?
clue_et: Millised väikesed Vene ja Siberi tainataskud peidavad õhukeses tainas maitsestatud toorest liha ning jõuavad lauale sageli või või hapukoorega?
explanation_en: Pelmeni are boiled from fresh or frozen and traditionally use a compact meat filling inside unleavened dough.
explanation_et: Pelmeenid keedetakse värskelt või külmutatult ning nende pärmita tainas ümbritseb tihedat lihatäidist.

clue_en: Polish cooks boil these crescent-shaped parcels, often filled with potato and cheese, and may then fry them with onion. What are they?
clue_et: Poolas keedetakse neid poolkuukujulisi, sageli kartuli ja juustuga täidetud tainataskuid ning praetakse vahel hiljem sibulaga. Mis need on?
explanation_en: Pierogi are filled Polish dumplings whose many savoury and sweet versions are boiled before optional pan-frying.
explanation_et: Pierogi on Poola täidetud tainataskud, mille soolased ja magusad variandid keedetakse ning soovi korral praetakse pannil üle.

clue_en: These Japanese crescent parcels, adapted from Chinese jiaozi, are commonly browned on one side and then steamed in the same pan. Name them.
clue_et: Neid Hiina jiaozi'st kohandatud Jaapani poolkuukujulisi tainataskuid pruunistatakse tavaliselt ühelt küljelt ja aurutatakse siis samal pannil. Mis need on?
explanation_en: The popular yaki-gyōza method gives the base a crisp crust while steam cooks the wrapper and filling.
explanation_et: Levinud yaki-gyōza valmistusviis teeb põhja krõbedaks, samal ajal kui aur küpsetab taina ja täidise.

clue_en: Which Jiangnan speciality is steamed in a bamboo basket and releases hot broth from inside its thin wrapper when bitten?
clue_et: Milline Jiangnani roog aurutatakse bambuskorvis ning vabastab hammustamisel õhukese taina seest kuuma puljongi?
explanation_en: Xiaolongbao enclose meat and chilled gelled stock; the stock melts into soup during steaming.
explanation_et: Xiaolongbao sisse pannakse liha ja külm tarretunud puljong, mis sulab aurutamisel supiks.

clue_en: In Turkey, which tiny Kayseri dumplings are served with yoghurt, melted butter, dried mint, and Aleppo pepper?
clue_et: Milliseid Kayseri pisikesi tainataskuid serveeritakse Türgis jogurti, sulavõi, kuivatatud mündi ja Aleppo pipraga?
explanation_en: Manti belong to a broad family of Turkic and Central Asian filled dumplings with regional shapes and sauces.
explanation_et: Manti kuulub türgi ja Kesk-Aasia täidetud tainataskute suurde perekonda, mille kuju ja lisandid piirkonniti erinevad.

clue_en: Its dough is twisted into a looped knot, dipped in an alkaline bath, and baked with coarse salt. Name this Central European bakery staple.
clue_et: Selle pagaritoote tainas keeratakse aasaliseks sõlmeks, kastetakse aluselisse lahusesse ja küpsetatakse jämeda soolaga. Mis see on?
explanation_en: The alkaline treatment gives a pretzel its dark glossy crust and distinctive flavour while its knotted shape remains recognizable.
explanation_et: Aluseline töötlus annab soolakringlile tumeda läikiva kooriku ja iseloomuliku maitse, sõlmjas kuju jääb aga äratuntavaks.

clue_en: Hungarian herders gave their name to which paprika-rich meat-and-vegetable soup or stew?
clue_et: Milline paprikarohke liha ja köögiviljadega supp või hautis sai nime Ungari karjustelt?
explanation_en: Gulyás began as a herders' dish; paprika became a defining flavour after the spice spread through Hungarian cooking.
explanation_et: Gulyás sai alguse karjuste roast; paprika muutus selle põhimaitseks pärast vürtsi levikut Ungari köögis.

clue_en: Austria's best-known cutlet is traditionally thin veal coated in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs before frying. What is it called?
clue_et: Austria tuntuim kotlet on traditsiooniliselt õhuke vasikaliha, mis paneeritakse jahus, munas ja riivsaias ning praetakse. Mis on selle nimi?
explanation_en: A true Wiener schnitzel uses veal; similar breaded cutlets made from pork are normally labelled by the meat used.
explanation_et: Ehtne Viini šnitsel valmistatakse vasikalihast; samal viisil paneeritud sealiha nimetuses tuuakse tavaliselt liha eraldi välja.

clue_en: Which Austrian rolled pastry wraps spiced orchard fruit in dough stretched so thin that a newspaper can traditionally be read through it?
clue_et: Milline Austria rullitud küpsetis mähib vürtsitatud puuviljatäidise tainasse, mis venitatakse pärimuse järgi nii õhukeseks, et sellest saab ajalehte läbi lugeda?
explanation_en: Apple strudel rolls sliced apples and spices inside an exceptionally thin sheet of stretched dough.
explanation_et: Õunastruudel keerab viilutatud õunad ja vürtsid erakordselt õhukeseks venitatud tainalehe sisse.

clue_en: At an Alpine table, a half-wheel of cheese is heated and its softened face scraped over potatoes and pickles. Which Swiss dish is this?
clue_et: Alpi söögilauas kuumutatakse poolikut juusturatast ning pehme pind kraabitakse kartulitele ja hapukurkidele. Milline Šveitsi roog see on?
explanation_en: Raclette names both the meltable cheese and the communal dish made by scraping its heated surface onto accompaniments.
explanation_et: Raclette tähistab nii hästi sulavat juustu kui ka ühisrooga, mille puhul kuumutatud juust lisanditele kraabitakse.

clue_en: Across Indonesia and its neighbours, which skewers of seasoned meat are grilled over a fire and commonly paired with a peanut sauce?
clue_et: Milliseid maitsestatud lihavardaid grillitakse Indoneesias ja naabermaades tule kohal ning pakutakse sageli maapähklikastmega?
explanation_en: Satay developed in Java and spread across Southeast Asia, where meats, marinades, and accompanying sauces vary.
explanation_et: Satay kujunes Jaaval ja levis üle Kagu-Aasia, kus liha, marinaad ja lisandikaste piirkonniti erinevad.

clue_en: Which spicy noodle soup from Malaysia and Singapore often builds its broth from coconut milk or sour tamarind and is associated with Peranakan cooking?
clue_et: Milline Malaisia ja Singapuri vürtsikas nuudlisupp saab puljongi sageli kookospiimast või hapust tamarindist ning seostub peranakani köögiga?
explanation_en: Laksa is a family of noodle soups whose major styles include creamy curry laksa and tart fish-based asam laksa.
explanation_et: Laksa on nuudlisuppide perekond, mille põhistiilid on kreemjas karri-laksa ja hapukas kalapõhine asam laksa.

clue_en: Minangkabau cooks slowly reduce beef with coconut milk and spices until the liquid is gone and the meat is dark and intensely flavoured. Name the dish.
clue_et: Minangkabau köögis hautatakse veiseliha kookospiima ja vürtsidega, kuni vedelik kaob ning liha muutub tumedaks ja maitseküllaseks. Mis roog see on?
explanation_en: Rendang's long reduction fries the meat in the coconut's released oil, helping the spice coating cling and concentrate.
explanation_et: Rendang'i pika hautamise lõpus praeb liha kookosest eraldunud õlis ning vürtsikiht kinnitub ja muutub kontsentreeritumaks.

clue_en: In a mortar, Thai cooks pound shredded unripe papaya with lime, chilli, palm sugar, and fish sauce for which crisp salad?
clue_et: Tai köögis tambitakse uhmris ribastatud toorest papaiat laimi, tšilli, palmisuhkru ja kalakastmega. Milline krõmpsuv salat nii valmib?
explanation_en: Som tam balances sour, hot, sweet, and salty tastes while the firm unripe fruit keeps its crunch.
explanation_et: Som tam tasakaalustab haput, teravat, magusat ja soolast maitset ning kõva toores vili säilitab krõmpsu.

clue_en: Which Thai soup combines chicken and coconut milk with galangal, lemongrass, and makrut lime leaves?
clue_et: Milline Tai supp ühendab kana ja kookospiima galangali, sidrunheina ning makrut-laimi lehtedega?
explanation_en: The name identifies boiled galangal with chicken, while coconut milk carries the soup's aromatic herbs and sour heat.
explanation_et: Nimi viitab keedetud kalganile kanaga, kookospiim aga kannab supi aromaatseid ürte, hapet ja teravust.

clue_en: Which crisp South Indian crepe is spread thin on a hot griddle from a fermented batter of rice and black gram?
clue_et: Milline krõbe Lõuna-India pannkook küpsetatakse kuumal plaadil õhukeseks kääritatud riisi ja musta mungoa tainast?
explanation_en: Fermentation gives dosa batter flavour and lift; the batter can be cooked plain or wrapped around a potato filling.
explanation_et: Käärimine annab dosa-tainale maitse ja kohevuse; seda küpsetatakse niisama või keeratakse kartulitäidise ümber.

clue_en: Created in Delhi, which dish folds pieces roasted in a tandoor into a smooth tomato-and-cream sauce?
clue_et: Milline Delhis loodud roog paneb tandooris röstitud lihatükid siidisesse tomati-koorekastmesse?
explanation_en: Butter chicken, or murgh makhani, was devised as a way to keep leftover tandoori chicken tender in a rich sauce.
explanation_et: Võikana ehk murgh makhani loodi selleks, et järelejäänud tandoorikana püsiks rikkalikus kastmes mahlane.

clue_en: Which Mughal-influenced curry gently braises meat or vegetables with yoghurt or cream, spices, and sometimes ground nuts?
clue_et: Milline Mogulite mõjuga karri hautab liha või köögivilju õrnalt jogurti või koore, vürtside ja vahel jahvatatud pähklitega?
explanation_en: Korma describes a family of mild, aromatic braises whose sauce can be thickened with dairy, nuts, or seeds.
explanation_et: Korma on mahedate aromaatsete hautiste perekond, mille kastet paksendatakse piimatoodete, pähklite või seemnetega.

clue_en: Portuguese sailors brought a wine-and-garlic meat preparation to Goa, where local cooks transformed it with vinegar and spices into which curry?
clue_et: Portugali meremehed tõid Goasse veini ja küüslauguga liharoa, mille kohalikud kokad muutsid äädika ning vürtsidega milliseks karriks?
explanation_en: Vindaloo developed from carne de vinha d'alhos; its Goan form uses vinegar, garlic, and a distinctive spice mixture.
explanation_et: Vindaloo arenes roast carne de vinha d'alhos; Goa versioon kasutab äädikat, küüslauku ja iseloomulikku vürtsisegu.

clue_en: Which South Asian sweet fries balls made from concentrated milk solids and soaks them in a rose- or cardamom-scented syrup?
clue_et: Millise Lõuna-Aasia maiuse jaoks praetakse kontsentreeritud piimakuivainest pallid ja leotatakse neid roosi või kardemoni lõhnalises siirupis?
explanation_en: Gulab jamun uses khoya or milk powder for its soft fried dumplings, which absorb warm aromatic syrup.
explanation_et: Gulab jamun'i pehmed praetud pallid tehakse khoya'st või piimapulbrist ning need imavad sooja aromaatse siirupi endasse.

category_name_en: From the Levant to North Africa
clue_en: A conical earthenware pot and the Moroccan slow-cooked stew prepared inside it share what name?
clue_et: Millist nime kannavad nii koonilise kaanega savinõu kui ka selles valmiv Maroko aeglaselt hautatud roog?
explanation_en: A tagine's tall lid returns condensed steam to the stew, allowing slow cooking with relatively little added water.
explanation_et: Tagine'i kõrge kaas juhib kondenseerunud auru hautisse tagasi ja võimaldab aeglaselt küpsetada vähese lisatud veega.

category_name_en: From the Levant to North Africa
clue_en: Which Levantine salad makes chopped parsley the star, with smaller amounts of bulgur, tomato, mint, lemon, and olive oil?
clue_et: Millises Levandi salatis on peaosas hakitud petersell ning kõrval väiksem kogus bulgurit, tomatit, münti, sidrunit ja oliiviõli?
explanation_en: Traditional tabbouleh is herb-forward rather than grain-heavy, with parsley providing most of its volume and colour.
explanation_et: Traditsiooniline tabbouleh on pigem ürdi- kui teraviljarohke: suurema osa mahust ja värvist annab petersell.

category_name_en: From the Levant to North Africa
clue_en: Roasted aubergine is mashed with tahini, lemon, and garlic for which smoky Levantine dip?
clue_et: Röstitud baklažaan tambitakse tahini, sidruni ja küüslauguga milliseks suitsumaitseliseks Levandi dipiks?
explanation_en: Charring the aubergine before mixing its flesh with sesame paste gives baba ghanoush its characteristic smokiness.
explanation_et: Baklažaani kõrvetamine enne viljaliha seesamipastaga segamist annab baba ghanoush'ile iseloomuliku suitsususe.

category_name_en: From the Levant to North Africa
clue_en: Which Levantine dip from Aleppo blends red peppers and walnuts with breadcrumbs and pomegranate molasses?
clue_et: Milline Aleppost pärit Levandi dip ühendab punase paprika ja Kreeka pähklid riivsaia ning granaatõunamelassiga?
explanation_en: Muhammara is an Aleppo-born dip whose sweet-tart pomegranate molasses balances red pepper and walnuts.
explanation_et: Muhammara on Aleppost pärit dip, milles magushapu granaatõunamelass tasakaalustab punast paprikat ja Kreeka pähkleid.

category_name_en: From the Levant to North Africa
clue_en: Which Levantine salad turns pieces of toasted or fried flatbread into a main ingredient and seasons its vegetables with tangy sumac?
clue_et: Millises Levandi salatis saavad röstitud või praetud lameleivatükid põhikoostisosaks ning köögivilju maitsestab hapukas sumahh?
explanation_en: Fattoush belongs to the fattat family of dishes that make practical use of pieces of stale or toasted bread.
explanation_et: Fattoush kuulub fattat-roogade perekonda, kus kasutatakse nutikalt kuivanud või röstitud leivatükke.

clue_en: Chocolate sponge, cherries, and whipped cream form which German cake whose name evokes a wooded region?
clue_et: Milline Saksa tort ühendab šokolaadibiskviidi, kirsid ja vahukoore ning kannab metsase piirkonna nime?
explanation_en: Its German name is Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte, literally Black Forest cherry cake, reflecting its chocolate, cream, and cherry layers.
explanation_et: Saksa nimi Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte tähendab sõna-sõnalt Schwarzwaldi kirsitorti ning viitab šokolaadi-, koore- ja kirsikihtidele.

clue_en: Which dense Viennese chocolate cake layers apricot jam beneath a dark glaze and is traditionally served with unsweetened whipped cream?
clue_et: Milline tihe Viini šokolaadikook peidab tumeda glasuuri all aprikoosimoosi ning seda serveeritakse traditsiooniliselt magustamata vahukoorega?
explanation_en: Franz Sacher created the cake in Vienna; its contrast of chocolate and apricot became the signature of the later hotel.
explanation_et: Franz Sacher lõi koogi Viinis ning šokolaadi ja aprikoosi kontrastist sai hilisema hotelli tunnus.

clue_en: Which Portuguese egg-custard pastry, optionally dusted with cinnamon, was inspired by an original recipe created by monks at Lisbon's Jerónimos Monastery in Belém?
